subject: MAP Readout: Data handling & deployment constraints for Acme POC
messages:
From: Claire Jensen <claire.jensen@acmecorp.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-12T08:14:00Z
Subject: MAP kickoff & questions on data handling (Acme POC)

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the demo earlier this week — Acme is excited to move to a short POC. Procurement asked that we capture a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) covering milestones, data handling constraints, and deployment choices (VPC vs on-prem) so legal and security can triage.

Top asks from our side to include in the MAP:
- Confirmation whether Redwood can support an air-gapped / on-prem deployment for the POC (timeline + blockers)
- Retention policy options for logs and inputs (30/90/365 days) and whether we can restrict KV cache for PII
- KMS/HSM support and certificate rotation cadence
- A single-page list of required evidence for procurement/security (SOC2, encryption at rest, data flow diagram)

We can share a short timeline: 6-week POC with go/no-go at week 4. Can you propose owners and a few decisions for this week’s checkpoint?

Best,
Claire Jensen
Head of AI Partnerships, Acme Corp

(Attachment: acme_map_initial_draft.pdf)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Claire Jensen <claire.jensen@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-12T10:03:00Z
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff & questions on data handling (Acme POC)

Claire — thanks for the clear asks. Good news: we can support both Hosted+VPC and a Private on-prem deployment for the POC, but there are trade-offs and lead times I want to call out up front. Proposed quick decisions for this week’s checkpoint:

1) Deployment mode for week 1–4: Hosted API routed to a customer-dedicated VPC (expected delivery: 2 weeks).
2) On-prem feasibility: engineering can provide a reference on-prem image but full air-gap setup will need 4–6 weeks and a short integration sprint.
3) Retention baseline: default logs 30 days; we can extend to 90/365 with a signed retention addendum (procurement).
4) PII handling: we’ll disable KV prefix caching for any fields marked PII in the POC dataset; redaction options available.

Owners I’m proposing:
- Technical lead & integration: Karthik Iyer (redwood infra)
- Security/compliance liaison: Evelyn Hart (redwood security)
- MAP owner & procurement point: Monica Patel (sales)

I’ll coordinate a short 30-minute checkpoint today at 2 PM ET to confirm. Attaching our filled security questionnaire for procurement to speed review.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

(Attachment: redwood_security_questionnaire_filled.xlsx)

Subject: RE: MAP kickoff & questions on data handling (Acme POC) — 2 PM checkpoint notes

Thanks all for the quick call — notes below (chronological / action-focused).

Meeting notes (2026-06-12 14:00 ET)
- Attendees: Claire (Acme), Aditya, Monica, Evelyn, Karthik
- Purpose: agree initial deployment mode and owners, document PII handling, and list procurement evidence.

Decisions made:
- Short-term deployment (weeks 1–4): Hosted with a dedicated VPC (private subnets) — minimizes lead time and gives Acme network isolation.
- Long-term / air-gap: on-prem image available; expected 4–6 week integration + security sign-off.
- Retention: Default 30-day logs for POC. If Acme needs 90-day, procurement to approve retention amendment.
- PII: Any field labeled PII in Acme dataset will be redacted client-side before ingestion OR flagged in metadata so we disable KV prefix caching for those requests.

Action items (owner — due)
- Karthik Iyer — produce VPC architecture diagram and on-prem integration checklist (due 2026-06-16).
- Evelyn Hart — compile SOC2 + encryption at rest notes and list of evidence items procurement needs (due 2026-06-15).
- Monica Patel — draft MAP timeline (6-week POC) and procurement ask list (due 2026-06-14).
- Aditya Rao — prepare short decision matrix (VPC vs on-prem trade-offs) and share with Claire (due 2026-06-13).

Risks / open questions:
- Certificate rotation for on-prem customers: confirm customer KMS readiness. (Evelyn to validate with Acme PKI team).
- Data residency: Acme requested EU region for long-term; for POC US region acceptable. If EU required, lead time increases.

Claire — please confirm the due dates above and whether we should add any additional procurement evidence.

— Monica

Subject: Re: RE: MAP kickoff & questions on data handling (Acme POC) — VPC/on-prem tech note

On Fri, Jun 12, 2026 at 14:05 Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com> wrote:
> Meeting notes (2026-06-12 14:00 ET)
> - Attendees: Claire (Acme), Aditya, Monica, Evelyn, Karthik
> - Purpose: agree initial deployment mode and owners, document PII handling, and list procurement evidence.

Quick technical follow-up and clarifications from my side:

- VPC option: we’ll provision a dedicated VPC peering + NAT for outbound model updates. Expected infra lead time: ~8 business days once we have subnet CIDR and peering approvals.
- On-prem image: we provide a hardened container image + bootstrap script. Air-gapped installs will require 2 engineer-days on the customer site (or remote with approved tunnels) plus signed patching SLA.
- Retention enforcement: we support server-side configurable retention per customer; for POC we’ll default to 30 days and apply a retention tag to Acme logs for easy querying.
- PII mitigation: two options — client-side redaction (recommended) OR server-side tokenization. Server-side tokenization will store tokens in a secure store; we will disable any KV prefix caching for PII-tagged requests.

I attached a lightweight checklist for VPC and on-prem steps and a sample network diagram (in Drive link).

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Infra Engineer | Redwood Inference

Subject: MAP checkpoint — updated checklist & next steps

Claire / team — thanks for the time today. Per the meeting and the notes below, I’ve consolidated the MAP checkpoint items into the POC checklist so procurement and security have one living document. High level summary and next steps: 

Summary decisions
- POC deployment: Hosted -> Dedicated VPC (weeks 1–4).
- On-prem: feasible, requires 4–6 week effort for air-gap readiness.
- Retention: 30-day default; 90/365 by amendment.
- PII: client-side redaction preferred; server-side tokenization available if required.

Immediate next steps
- Monica to share MAP timeline (due 2026-06-14).
- Karthik to upload VPC diagram and on-prem checklist to the shared Drive and flag any required CIDR info (due 2026-06-16).
- Evelyn to circulate the minimal evidence packet for procurement (SOC2 excerpts, encryption notes) and a short FAQ for Acme PKI (due 2026-06-15).
- Claire / Acme: confirm whether client-side redaction is in scope for the POC and provide an initial sample dataset (anonymized) we can use for evaluation (due 2026-06-18).

I’ll keep this thread as the MAP checkpoint record. If there are no objections, Monica will push the MAP to HubSpot and share the doc link.

Thanks — looking forward to getting the POC started.
